purpose: Internal demo and automated report-pipeline testing

checks.note: A weekend or market holiday can legitimately add calendar-day lag.
The two global series use related but not identical benchmark definitions.

known_limitations: The I0 series is provider-constructed continuous futures data, not a single contract.
The China futures price is CNY per metric ton while global benchmarks are nominal USD per metric ton.
No FX, port inventory, steel output, freight, or grade-premium series is included yet.
Corporate source cards are supply-context observations, not independent market forecasts.
recommended_automated_tests: Unique and strictly increasing trading date
Required OHLCV and open-interest fields are non-null
high >= max(open, low, close) and low <= min(open, high, close)
No negative volume or open interest
Latest trading date freshness within five calendar days during normal markets
Every generated report metric includes source_id and observation date
